title: Clock Jitter Measurement
text: Measure jitter in periodic signals, 1 input, 3 outputs; {Clock Frequency} sets the frequency of input clock, {Threshold}, {Period Jitter} sets the rMS period jitter, {Cycle-2-Cycle (C2C) Jitter} sets the rMS cycle-to-cycle jitter, {Duty Cycle Distortion (DCD)} sets the duty cycle distortion for each cycle and {Simulate using} selects simulation mode. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Period Jitter
ports.summary: Running RMS value of period jitter scalar

ports.name: C2C
ports.summary: Running RMS value of cycle-to-cycle jitter scalar

ports.name: DCD
ports.summary: Difference between real duty cycle and 50% value scalar

params.name: Clock Frequency
params.values: Frequency of input clock signal 1e6 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Duty Cycle Distortion (DCD)
params.values: Duty cycle distortion for each cycle off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Select simulation mode Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
